title: Leonida Platinum Playbook

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own — there is nothing extra to do for it. Work the roadmap in order: story first, then strangers, activities and robberies, and the 100% checklist last. PowerPyx puts the whole run at roughly 200 hours at difficulty 4 out of 10, so treat this as the finish line, not a task.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission Gone Fishing. It is the first story trophy and unlocks naturally as you play the intro — no preparation and no side requirement.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. Before the chapter ends, do the missable balcony meditation with Lucia at Jason's house (see Positive Mental Attitude) — it is the one thing in this chapter that can go away.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. By now Jason and Lucia are both playable, which opens the partner trophies — several of them need the two of them together, so most of the list only opens up from here.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Story only — keep playing the main missions and it unlocks at the chapter's end.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. Story only — it unlocks as the chapter closes, so there is nothing to prepare or grind for it.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. PowerPyx and GTABase both advise keeping a manual save before it: GTA 6 has no mission replay, so a save lets you revisit the ending and mop up anything left behind afterwards.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. It is a story mission, so it unlocks by playing through the main path — no side objective is attached to it.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. Story only — it pops when the heist mission is finished.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. Story only — finish the mission and the trophy follows.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. Story only — it unlocks when the mission is done.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. Story only — play the mission through to its end.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. Story only — it unlocks when the mission is finished.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The checklist appears under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion, only after the story — but everything you did before already counts. GTABase breaks it down as 45% story and tasks, 45% exploration and activities, 10% discovery, and it asks for selected shares rather than everything: 300 of 397 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 18 meditations, 200 of 277 vehicle scans. Nothing on the checklist is missable, so this is the long post-story cleanup, not a race.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts: stunt jumps, driving under bridges, knife flights and base jumps all count. The 100% checklist wants 300 of the 397 available, so keep going past this trophy — fold stunts into normal travel instead of grinding them in one sitting.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once — U7BUY counts nine activity types. Open the map and sample one of everything on offer: races, the shooting range, fishing, the arcade, bowling, drone races and the rest. One try each is enough; you do not need to win or finish anything.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Work through the ranges one by one and learn each one's timing and target pattern — a gold in every challenge is the requirement, and the 100% checklist wants the same 42, so this trophy and the checklist finish together.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location — 14 locations, with 42 drone time trials between them according to KeenGamer and GTABase. Learn each course's line before racing it flat out; one win per location is all the trophy asks for.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — variety matters, not repeats of the same one. The 100% checklist asks for 30 race wins, so keep racing after this pops; try a new race type each time rather than farming a favourite.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at a fishing spot and win the head-to-head — fishing is one of the early activities, so this is available long before the endgame. Bring the better rod and bait if the challenge offers them.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Walk into any arcade and play one game through to its end — any title counts, and you only need to finish it, not set a record.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Follow Andy's quest line to its end — his missions show up as you progress, so check the map for his marker between story beats and clear each one as it appears.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Work through Kenton's quest line mission by mission until his final one unlocks — it is a character strand, not a story chapter, so it can be finished whenever his missions are available.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Follow Billy's quest line to its final mission. GTABase lists the character quest lines (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret) as a group worth clearing in the same phase of the game.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Stranger missions are marked on the map — pick eight full strands and see each through to its end. GTABase notes stranger missions are not part of the 100% checklist, so this is a trophy-only task; do it in the side-mission phase, not the cleanup phase.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Clear Randy's missions as they appear and finish his final one — like the other character strands, it stays available in free roam after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Work Tyrone's quest line to its final mission. If his marker is not showing, advance the story a little — character missions unlock as the chapters progress.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots in total, tracked under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. THE missable one: during Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia mentions meditating at Jason's house in the morning — follow her to the balcony and accept. That session is gone after Chapter 1, and it is not yet confirmed whether the trophy needs it, so do it anyway and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops. At the outdoor spots, meditating with both Jason and Lucia counts twice, so bring your partner every time.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's strand is his hunting quest line — take the unique-animal contract and bring the animal down. GTABase lists Bret's 15 Target Decks among the 100% requirements, so finishing his strand also feeds the checklist.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida — collect full sets, three of them. The 100% checklist wants all 15 sets, so keep collecting long after this trophy pops.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app to scan at 100 locations. Scan anything unfamiliar as you travel — vehicles, landmarks, animals — and the count climbs on its own. The 100% checklist also wants 100 WAiNK scans, so this trophy and the checklist finish together.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges cover combat, driving, exploration and more — they accumulate across everything you do, so play widely rather than farming one type. The 100% checklist wants 70 of the 80, so treat 50 as the halfway mark.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Build 4 stars with Jason and Lucia together, then break line of sight and stay hidden until it clears. Quiet back roads and cover beat a highway chase — do not outrun the law, outwait it.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Hit three shops in a row with your partner beside you and keep the wanted level alive between them — plan a tight route with three close shops and a fast getaway car before you start.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — scan or drive new vehicles to log them. The 100% checklist wants 200 of 277 scanned, so keep scanning past this trophy; every new model you meet on the road counts.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus in a busy fight and chain five takedowns before it ends — pick a mission or shootout with clustered enemies so you are not hunting for the fifth one as the timer runs out.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — steal a plane at Vice City International Airport and take off. Expect a wanted level the moment you grab it, so take off fast, climb steeply and do not linger on the runway.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos — get behind the wheel of a Rhino tank. Tanks show up at military spots; stealing one draws heavy attention, so plan your exit route before you climb in.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet — no alarms, no one spotting you — take the goods and get out before anyone raises the alarm. If you are seen, leave and try again rather than fighting through it.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Bank vaults are the big jobs — the 100% checklist wants all 8 vaults plus 22 bank jobs, so this trophy is a milestone on the way, not the end of the robbery grind.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Ambush a truck on the road, crack it open, grab the cash and break away before the response arrives — a fast car parked nearby matters more than firepower.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — clear the map fog everywhere. A plane clears fog fastest, as reported from PowerPyx's footage: fly a grid over the state and mop up the corners on foot or by car afterwards.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Hit one illegal operation per gang across the map. The 100% checklist wants all 39 gang operations, so this trophy is the first pass — keep clearing them after it pops.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view — the description is the whole method, and it is one of the gentlest trophies on the list.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Method unconfirmed. The description reads as a showroom smash — drive a car out of a vehicle showroom through the glass, classic GTA style — but no launch-era guide has confirmed the exact trigger yet, so treat this as a lead, not a fact. Check PowerPyx and GTABase as players confirm it, and do not burn a save on a guess.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Method unconfirmed. The description points to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — a follow-through, most likely a full game or a strike sequence there, is the likely trigger — but no launch-era guide has confirmed the exact requirement yet. Play a game there and check PowerPyx and GTABase for the confirmed method.
trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Method unconfirmed. 'A partnership with mass appeal' reads as a story or partner moment, but its trigger is not public yet — no launch-era guide pins it down. Do not grind for it on a guess; check PowerPyx and GTABase as the community confirms the method.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Method unconfirmed. 'Choices made (for better or worse)' points at the Criminal Profile system, and EGamers reports GTABase listing 500 profile-changing actions — but from a single source, which is not confirmed. Do not grind 500 actions on that rumour alone; wait for PowerPyx or GTABase to confirm the number.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Method unconfirmed. 'Second time's the charm' suggests retrying something that first went wrong — a failed attempt followed by a success — but no launch-era guide has confirmed what the attempt is. Watch PowerPyx and GTABase for the confirmed method.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Method unconfirmed. 'What the hell just happened?' reads as a strange world event or encounter, but its trigger is not confirmed in any launch-era guide. It will most likely surface as players report odd encounters — check PowerPyx and GTABase rather than hunting blind.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Method unconfirmed. 'Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by' suggests knocking targets over with a melee attack from a moving vehicle, most likely near a bowling alley, but no launch-era guide has confirmed the exact requirement. Treat this as a lead and check PowerPyx and GTABase for the confirmed method.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Launder marked bills steadily through your contacts — the total is cumulative, so every laundered dollar counts. The 100% checklist also tracks fencing totals, so this feeds the cleanup phase.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy weapons, clothes, cars and upgrades across Leonida — spending counts cumulatively across every shop, so this climbs on its own if you keep yourself well equipped.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy every garage on the market — they also give you somewhere to store the vehicles you register for On the Spot, so buy them before you start collecting cars in earnest.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the app and register ten different vehicles you own or find — any ten count, so use the cars you already drive.
trophies.name: On the Spot
